column1: # FIXTURE-ONLY verification of private_compiler_build.sh's LIVE-IMPORTER guard.
# live guard body from the build script and points it at a throwaway
# project-local root, against which it spawns four short-lived processes with
# known properties.  Each is killed BY PID; no pgrep pattern is used anywhere,
# because a pattern that matches a waiter's command line matches the waiter.
# WHAT THE EARLIER GUARDS GOT WRONG, and what these cases pin down:
#   * an argv grep would have REFUSED D (argv merely names the root) and MISSED
#     B (found the root through the environment, argv is relative);
#   * the ancestor walk excluded every DESCENDANT of the invoking shell -- which
#     A, B, C and D all are -- so it would have reported a clean context with
# C holds its mapping through an open fd, so the fd probe fires first: it is
# detected as a reader, by fd rather than by the maps probe. Recorded as observed.
